cause_quote: The new gesture runtime’s `connect()` ran `if (this.host.navDrawerOpen) { this.opened(); }`, and `opened()` moved focus with `(this.focusable()[0] ?? drawer)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });`.
user_saw: If swipe support loaded while the mobile sidebar roster menu was open, the menu lost keyboard focus and the first Escape press could dismiss an unrelated tooltip.
summary: The fix moves initial drawer focus into the shell’s open transition so attaching gesture listeners preserves the active menu item.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and confirmed that the same squash merge added the lazy import and the connection callback that refocused an already-open drawer. The fix’s test isolates that original timing bug by focusing a nested control before connecting the gesture runtime.
